label: SYNTHETIC BENCHMARK

spatial_analysis.region_note: Regions notch_delta and top_grip_delta may overlap only if geometry permits; counts explicitly reported. Cross-plane failure advance is a set of original bond intersections, not a reconstructed continuous crack surface.

quantitative_response.force_semantics: Raw reaction_N is minus the internal/contact force resultant on the top identity set. It is a mechanical reaction term only while controlled. Actual actuator additionally includes prescribed top inertia; after release the actuator is zero, not the raw top-set resultant.

chunk_time_semantics.note: An anchor-free component containing a prescribed grip is GRIPPED until the common 2 ms release. A change in free classification at release is not a bond-breaking event.
